body:
Founder real-time: 'can we make it so the level editor there is a visual indicator for the level exit marker? im not sure if it works because i dont know if its in the right spot.' Found live: none of NavNode/Character/LevelExit had a 3D viewport marker before this (only walls/spawn points did). Closed for LevelExit specifically: Viewport3D gains a new levelExits prop, rendered as a cyan octahedron at the exit's own position plus a wireframe sphere sized to its real radius. Read-only display v0, not yet click-to-select/drag. NavNode/Character named as the same remaining gap, not fixed this pass. Verified the new code landed in both the built JS bundle and the deployed Go binary (dist/ is go:embed'd) before restarting iduna.service. Commits: 0537469, 78e5e36.

⚓ ☃
title: Real 3D marker for level exits in the NOCK level editor
